title: Some investors and founders say they lost an ally in Jensen Huang; Nvidia held $48B in 229 private companies as of July and offered $165B in cloud backstops (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Some investors and founders say they lost an ally in Jensen Huang; Nvidia held $48B in 229 private companies as of July and offered $165B in cloud backstops — Mr. Huang championed start-ups, with Nvidia holding $48 billion worth of stakes in 229 private companies, including OpenAI and Anthropic, at the end of July.
